title: Study for Vermicular Calligraphy I
description: An asymmetrical rubbing of the inner bark of a dead tree occupies the center of a vertically oriented white page. The woodgrain texture is interrupted by meandering white lines created by boring insects.
provenance: Artist Cui Fei, (2023-2025), sold; to the Harvard Art Museums, 2025.
credit_line: Harvard Art Museums/Arthur M. Sackler Museum, Purchase through the generosity of Christina Marcove

title: Pine – The Universe in a Nutshell, from the Whispers of Trees series
material: Hanging scroll; inkjet print and metallic pigment on Xuan paper
description: A square black and white photograph is mounted on a white hanging scroll with silver edging. In the photograph, two thick pine branches lie horizontally on a blank surface, casting shadows downward. Upon close inspection, Chinese writing is in silver ink is visible in the shadows.
provenance: Artist Chu Chu, (2017-2025), sold; [through Alisan Fine Arts, NY]; to the Harvard Art Museums, 2025.

title: Magnolia – The Universe in a Nutshell, from the Whispers of Trees series
material: Hanging scroll; inkjet print and metallic pigment on Xuan paper
description: A square black and white photograph is mounted on a white hanging scroll with gold edging. title: 158,760 Pinpricks
description: On a horizontally oriented sheet of white paper with rough edges and a textured surface, geological forms appear in low relief. Fashioned from thousands of tiny holes rather than ink or color, the hills or cliff fill the page, bordered at the top by a sliver of blank sky and at the bottom by a narrow strip of beach and water.
provenance: Artist Fu Xiaotong, (2023-2025), sold; [through Alisan Fine Arts, NY]; to the Harvard Art Museums, 2025.
credit_line: Harvard Art Museums/Arthur M. Sackler Museum, Purchase through the generosity of Christina Marcove

title: Nighty Night I
material: Stoneware with white crackle glaze, white glow- -the-dark confetti glaze, and gold glaze
description: The spherical white vessel sits on a foot ring whose shape is echoed by the open vertical mouth at the top. One side has a large circular opening, from which emerge clusters of white pheres in varying sizes, as well as a few small gold spheres. The white spheres are covered in small holes, and two additional spheres are adhered to either side of the vessel, like knobs. The white glaze on the lower portion is matte and crackled, and the glaze on the upper portion is glossy and dotted with flecks of color.
provenance: Danyang Song, New York (created 2024), sold; through [LaiSun Keane, Boston, MA]; to Harvard Art Museums, 2025.
credit_line: Harvard Art Museums/Arthur M. Sackler Museum, Purchase through the generosity of Christina Marcove

title: Nighty Night II
material: Stoneware with white crackle glaze, white glow- -the-dark confetti glaze, and gold glaze
description: The sculpture’s shape evokes a hunched animal or snowman, consisting of three balls of diminishing size that are tipped slightly forward. Large nodules on the head and base recall ears and tail, and circular openings in the head mimic eyes and mouth. The surface is entirely covered in a white glaze flecked with color.
provenance: Danyang Song, New York (created 2024), sold; through [LaiSun Keane, Boston, MA]; to Harvard Art Museums, 2025.
credit_line: Harvard Art Museums/Arthur M. Sackler Museum, Purchase through the generosity of Christina Marcove

title: Untitled I
description: The tall neck-like vessel bulges slightly at the center, where it is split and has nodules in a variety of sizes spilling out from the fissure. The unglazed surface is a terracotta red that darkens at the upper edge.
provenance: Danyang Song, New York (created 2021), sold; through [LaiSun Keane, Boston, MA]; to Harvard Art Museums, 2025.
